replaces.idea: A pruned geometric bonsai tree in a ceramic tray whose stepped trunk splits into distinct leaf-pad canopies.
A tall apothecary cabinet with brass-rimmed cubbies holding glowing literal slugs.
A tabletop cast-iron paper guillotine slicing a continuous paper ribbon into discrete coloured chits.
A wall-mounted railway signal-box lever frame with two brass-handled switch levers above a diverging track plate.

new.name: Token Guillotine
new.concept: Lexical analysis (tokenizing a character stream into discrete tokens)
new.depicts: A tabletop cast-iron paper guillotine on four stubby feet, with a hinged brass blade arm raised over a cream paper ribbon emerging as cut coloured chits.
new.focal: The angled brass cutting blade poised above the notched paper strip.

new.name: Constant Cubbies
new.concept: Constant pool (deduplicated table of literals and symbolic references)
new.depicts: A tall dark-navy apothecary cabinet standing on a plinth, with a 3x3 grid of brass-rimmed cubbies holding glowing yellow and green literal slugs.
new.focal: One pulled-out cubby drawer gleaming with a bright yellow literal slug.

new.name: Branch Switch
new.concept: Control-flow graph (basic blocks connected by conditional jump edges)
new.depicts: A wall-mounted railway signal-box lever frame with a cast-iron base, two upright brass-handled levers, and a diverging Y-shaped track plate below.
new.focal: The two brass-tipped switch levers angled in opposite directions.

new.name: Syntax Bonsai
new.concept: Abstract syntax tree (hierarchical tree representation of source structure)
new.depicts: A pruned geometric bonsai tree potted in a dark-navy ceramic tray, its stepped amber trunk splitting into two green and yellow leaf-pad canopies.
new.focal: The asymmetric stepped trunk fork where the main branch splits.

new.name: Operand Dispenser
new.concept: Operand stack (LIFO stack used by stack-based bytecode VMs)
new.depicts: A spring-loaded vertical brass chute on a weighted base, holding three stacked square yellow-and-green value blocks with a side push-slot at the top.
new.focal: The top yellow value block peeking out of the dispenser slot.

new.name: Opcode Punch
new.concept: Bytecode instruction (compact fixed-width opcode and operand encoding)
new.depicts: A stiff cream-and-navy punch card standing upright in a slotted brass desk holder, perforated with two crisp square holes.
new.focal: The pair of dark punched holes near the upper-left corner.

new.name: Bytecode Metronome
new.concept: Instruction pointer (tracks the current bytecode offset being executed)
new.depicts: A pyramid-shaped dark-navy mechanical metronome on brass feet, with a pale-yellow pendulum needle tilted to the right.
new.focal: The bright yellow ticking pendulum arm.

new.name: Offset Caliper
new.concept: Line number table (maps bytecode offsets back to source-code lines)
new.depicts: A pair of hinged brass proportional dividers resting upright on a small wooden stand, with a tiny cream-ticked scale bar between the legs.
new.focal: The brass pivot screw linking the two pointed legs.
